slides.title: Dalal Street reopens with a *1.5% jump*
slides.stat_sub: First session after the Diwali holiday

slides.title: The *reopening* rally
points: Rally was **broad-based**, led by banks and autos
Cited drivers: **softer crude**, global cues, post-holiday buying

slides.title: India *defies* Wall Street
points: India opened higher despite a **weak US** session
Crude below **$100** helps India, a major oil importer
Banks are **heavyweights**, so their gains lift the indices

slides.title: Reaction vs *what to watch*
slides.note: Early-trade figures (around 9:20-9:40 AM IST); levels change through the day. Not investment advice.

slides.title: What investors should *know*
points: **Sensex** and **Nifty** jumped about 1.5% and 1.3% on reopening after Diwali
India rose even as **Wall Street fell** on Nov 10: S&P 500 -0.38%, Nasdaq -0.74%
**Crude and FPI flows** are the swing factors to track from here
